title: Well schematic view
status: gate met - every criterion, including a desktop overlay that hatches unverified barriers because the tools draw nothing for them

implementation.tools: TheTechIdea.OilGas.WellSchematic — WellSchematicTemplates, BarrierTemplates, SchematicAnnuli, WellSchematicValidator, TallyBuilder, SchematicTrack/BarrierOverlay

gates.AC-1 a well with casing and completion r: pass — the tools' gas-lift producer document has 7 strings whose Top/Bottom are ordered, including a casing string and a tubing/completion string; the schematic track is built from it and rendered by the smoke run
gates.AC-2 annuli show MAASP when the inputs e: pass — OgSchematicMapper.Annuli reports the MAASP with its unit or the exact phrase 'not computed' (never a blank), plus the screening result from SchematicAnnuli.Screen
gates.AC-3 an unverified barrier is visually d: pass - the tools draw nothing for Unverified, so OgSchematicBarrierOverlay adds a hatched amber band over each unverified interval, drawn by the host over the finished surface through ViewSurfaceRenderer.Overlay. Proven with ONE renderer instance: a no-op overlay leaves the frame byte-identical, the hatch changes it, and giving every barrier evidence yields no marks. Scope: only elements with a resolvable interval are hatched (1 of the demo's 12; the others carry no interval and target nothing that has geometry), and every unverified barrier is still named in the panel and counted in the summary.
gates.AC-4 an unknown component type produces: pass — an equipment row with ComponentType 'NOT_A_REAL_COMPONENT' and no symbol id produces a warning naming the type, and the well still renders with non-empty pixels
gates.AC-5 validation findings are listed with: pass — a string whose bottom is above its top produces a finding whose ItemId is that string's id
gates.AC-6 the tally matches the casing record: pass — the tally has one row per included string, RowIds are those strings' ids, and the top/bottom cells equal the strings' own depths

limits: The demo document is the tools' gas-lift producer with the production barrier template attached; no PPDM tubular record was read (DAT-02, G-08).
The production barrier template ships without verification evidence, so every demo barrier reads 'no evidence recorded' — realistic, but a verified example is unverified.

The hatch is a depth-aligned margin band, not a box over the casing column: the committed SchematicRenderPlan exposes no usable column or depth mapping after the draw (its depth area collapses to 1 px), so the band uses the canvas bounds and the document's own top and bottom.
The page was constructed by the smoke run and its panels read real rows; it was not clicked through in a shown window.
Tally column keys come from the environment's program-columns configuration; the test resolves 'top'/'bottom' by key rather than by position.
